key.name: mode
key.summary: What decides when the wallpaper changes
key.description: 'sun' follows sunrise and sunset at your location; 'fixed' uses day-start and night-start.

key.name: location-name
key.summary: Name of the chosen place, shown in the settings

key.name: day-start
key.summary: When day starts in 'fixed' mode, in minutes after midnight

key.name: night-start
key.summary: When night starts in 'fixed' mode, in minutes after midnight

key.name: wallpaper-sunrise
key.summary: Sunrise wallpaper (falls back to the day one)

key.name: wallpaper-sunset
key.summary: Sunset wallpaper (falls back to the day one)

key.name: transition-minutes
key.summary: How long the sunrise and sunset wallpapers show
key.description: The sunrise wallpaper starts at dawn, the sunset one ends at dusk.

key.name: fade-minutes
key.summary: How long each change of wallpaper takes
key.description: The old wallpaper fades into the new one over this many minutes, starting at the change. 0 swaps straight away. A fade is never longer than the wallpaper it fades into is shown for.

key.name: use-set
key.summary: Use the dynamic set instead of the day/night wallpapers

key.name: set-mode
key.summary: How the dynamic set is scheduled
key.description: 'time': each picture starts at a clock time. 'sun': each picture has a sun label (dawn, sunrise, midday...) worked out from the location, so it moves with the seasons.

key.name: set-folder
key.summary: Folder to pick dynamic set pictures from (a URI, empty for none)

key.name: set-images
key.summary: The dynamic set's pictures, as JSON
key.description: A list of {"uri": file URI, "time": minutes after midnight (time mode), "label": sun label id (sun mode)}.

key.name: switch-style
key.summary: Also switch between light and dark style
key.description: Light style during the day, dark at night. Off leaves the style alone.
